onboarding.IntroduceService1:
To help you get to know yourself better,
I'll send you a letter every day!
onboarding.IntroduceService2:
If you're not sure what to write,
you can read other letters for inspiration.
onboarding.IntroduceService3:
You can earn {reward} by sending letters
and use them to decorate me!
onboarding.IntroduceService4:
Keep sending letters,
and you might even get a reply from me!
onboarding.login:
If you log in,
I can remember the replies you've sent.

sign-up.question: What should I call you?
sign-up.name: My name is
sign-up.nameConditions1: You can enter between 2 and 8 characters.
sign-up.nameConditions2: Spaces, special characters, and uppercase English letters are not allowed.
sign-up.inviteCodePlaceholder: Enter an invite code if you have one

home.arrivalTitle:
A letter has arrived
Want to open it?

letter.title: {name}'s letter
letter.body:
It's me! {name}!
I really wanted to send {nickname} a letter,
so I practiced hard!
Today I rolled around, drying my face in the sun,
and wondered:
“{question}”
What do you think, {nickname}? I'm curious

letterWrite.placeholder: You can write up to {max} characters.
letterWrite.moodTitle:
Lastly,
how do you feel today?
letterWrite.moodDescription: It'll show on your monthly calendar.
letterWrite.costDescription: Replying to a past letter costs {count} dream pieces.
letterWrite.costInsufficientDescription: Watch an ad to collect dream pieces?

letterSent.shareTitle:

to help others?
